items.title: Jett McCandless named first FreightTech Vanguard Award winner at F3
items.content_html:
Jett McCandless, founder and CEO of project44 and LSP44, received the first FreightTech Vanguard Award at FreightWaves’ F3 Awards Dinner in Chattanooga, recognizing his contributions to logistics technology and innovation.
